children: Five people were shot dead at a residence in Douglas, Georgia, on October 9, the city's police department said on Saturday.

Officers with the Douglas Police Department responded late on Friday to a report of shots fired and found five people with gunshot wounds who were all pronounced dead, according to a police statement.
The investigation remains ongoing, the department added.
